note: Cached canonical HTML contract essentials from learn_post_authoring. Reuse across daily runs. The live account template evolved since June; the current established template mirrors the most recent published posts (e.g. post_3869bf49, 2026-08-17).

established_template.description: AI Current dark theme. Each block is a node-section div with data-background-color #222222; text sections add data-color #FFFFFF; padding 20 (ad sections use padding-top/bottom 12). Cover is a 16:9 imageBlock figure with 30px rounded corners and data-is-uploaded=true. Inline story images are imageBlock figures with 0 radius. Story sections use bold h2 headings (Models & Research, Products & Launches, Industry & Business). Structure: cover -> intro paragraph -> top ad (primary/with logo) -> grouped sections with inline images between them -> secondary ad -> sign-off -> secondary ad -> 'Share the newsletter' button. Sponsor blocks are labeled 'TOGETHER WITH OUR SPONSOR' (bold p) above the ad node.

ad_node.notes: data-id accepts an ad-network offer id (integer, from list_ad_offers available_offers) or an accepted opportunity UUID (from list_ad_opportunities). Embedding an available offer id auto-claims it and converts it to an accepted opportunity on save. data-advertisement-kind picks the creative variation: primary=with logo, secondary=no logo. Established layout uses primary for the top slot and secondary for the two bottom slots.

recipients_note: Publication has no active paid tier (list_tiers empty; ~10 free subscribers). Posts send to free on web + email. Set recipients {web:{tier_ids:[free]}, email:{tier_ids:[free]}} or omit to default to free.
